description: This file defines synchronization primitives such as CriticalSection, BinairySemaphore, CountingSemaphore, and Event, along with related utility classes and functions, for use within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows, and manages thread synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: CriticalSection
classes.description: A platform-specific critical section class providing mutual exclusion for thread synchronization.

classes.name: BinairySemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore with a binary state (locked/unlocked) for thread synchronization.

classes.name: CountingSemaphore
classes.description: A semaphore that maintains a count, allowing multiple threads to synchronize based on resource availability.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A synchronization event object that can be manually or automatically reset.

classes.name: SafeSyncType
classes.description: A template class providing RAII-style locking for synchronization objects.

methods.name: CriticalSection
methods.description: Constructor for CriticalSection object.

methods.name: CriticalSection::~CriticalSection
methods.description: Destructor for CriticalSection object.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Lock
methods.description: Locks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: CriticalSection::Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the critical section, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::BinairySemaphore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the semaphore with initial and maximum counts.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::~BinairySemaphore
methods.description: Destructor for BinairySemaphore.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the semaphore.

methods.name: BinairySemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Releases the semaphore.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::CountingSemaphore
methods.description: Constructor initializing the semaphore with initial and max counts.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::~CountingSemaphore
methods.description: Destructor for CountingSemaphore.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Lock
methods.description: Attempts to lock the semaphore.

methods.name: CountingSemaphore::Unlock
methods.description: Releases the semaphore, increasing the count.

methods.name: Event::Event
methods.description: Constructor for Event object, specifying initial state and reset mode.

methods.name: Event::~Event
methods.description: Destructor for Event object.

methods.name: Event::Lock
methods.description: Waits for the event to be signaled.

methods.name: Event::Unlock
methods.description: Signals the event.

methods.name: Event::ResetEvent
methods.description: Resets the event to non-signaled state.

methods.name: Event::SetEvent
methods.description: Sets the event to signaled state.

methods.name: Event::IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the event is in signaled state.

methods.name: SafeSyncType
methods.description: RAII class for automatic locking and unlocking of synchronization objects.

methods.name: InterlockedIncrement
methods.description: Atomically increments a 32-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: InterlockedDecrement
methods.description: Atomically decrements a 32-bit unsigned integer.
